scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm test --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.e2e:backend: cross-env DB_FILE=../data/techsubbies-e2e.db JWT_SECRET=techsubbies-e2e-secret-at-least-32-characters FRONTEND_ORIGIN=http://localhost:4173 E2E_AUTO_VERIFY_EMAIL=true PORT=4100 npm --prefix backend start
scripts.e2e:wait-and-run: wait-on http://localhost:4100/api/health http://localhost:4173 && npm run e2e:run
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:reset && concurrently --kill-others --success command-test --names backend,frontend,test "npm run e2e:backend" "npm run e2e:frontend" "npm run e2e:wait-and-run"
